create_quartz_dataset_with_knowledge: create a Quartz dataset instance in with_knowledge mode to load and preprocess the HuggingFace quartz dataset
create_quartz_dataset_no_knowledge: create a Quartz dataset instance in no_knowledge mode to load questions without background knowledge paragraphs
run_quartz_k_shot_generation: run the main function to generate 32-shot train dev and test splits for both knowledge modes
extract_choices_and_answer: extract choice labels and the correct answer string from a quartz datapoint dictionary
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace quartz dataset split to a list of input text and answer string tuples
